title: Ball Sort
description: Ball Sort Puzzle is a fun and addictive puzzle game! Try to sort the colored balls in the tubes until all balls with the same color stay in the same tube. A challenging yet relaxing game to exercise your brain!
instructions: HOW TO PLAY bull Tap any tube to move the ball lying on top of the tube to another tube bull The rule is that you can only move a ball on top of another ball if both of them have the same color and the tube you want to move into has enough space
